item.title: Life Logging: The Quiet Shift Toward Giving AI All Your Context
item.description: A reflection on how my personal AI usage has evolved from pasting error messages to full-blown life logging, and why I believe this trajectory — giving agents ever more context about your life — is how the future will unfold.
